How it works

Every hash is a score.

A wallet, a transaction, a block — on Ethereum it is all one thing: a hash. Audio Maps reads that hash and composes from it. No server, no randomness, no model. The chain is the score.

  1. 01
    Input. Any address, transaction, or block. All of it is a hash.
  2. 02
    Seed. The hash becomes a deterministic seed. Nothing is left to chance.
  3. 03
    Composition. The seed sets key, tempo, chord progression, melody and rhythm — a full piano piece.
  4. 04
    Vision. That same seed drives the colour, motion and chaos of the wave grid.
  5. 05
    Forever. The same input always sounds and looks identical. Play it a thousand times — it never drifts.

From the genesis block to the last mint of the day, every moment on Ethereum has always had a sound. This is the first time you can hear it.
